# ci-artifact-container spec

The `spec` block on this engine's entry in `forge-ci.yaml`.

| Key | Type | Required | Means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | string | yes | The registry repository, with NO tag. The tag is the version, which the core decides. |
| `movingTags` | list of strings | no | Convenience tags that point at the same index and move on every release, like "latest". Never something to pin. |
| `labels` | map of string to string | no | Labels written into every architecture's config. The version and the revision are written already. |
| `tokenEnv` | string | no | Environment variable holding the registry token. Defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN. |

forge-ci never validates a spec. This engine does, because only it knows what the keys mean.
